style: Soft painterly hand-drawn anime background art for a cozy desktop wallpaper, clean shapes, gentle gradients, warm Mediterranean seaside light, wide 16:9 composition. Original scene. No text, no letters, no watermark, no logo, no UI, no people, no characters, no animals.
terrace: a small whitewashed rooftop terrace by the sea, seen straight from the front at a slightly raised eye level: the terracotta tile floor fills the bottom 40% of the frame and is mostly open and empty in the middle so someone can walk across it; its back edge is a low white rounded parapet wall running straight across the whole width at about 58% of the frame height; on the left a long wooden bench with pale blue cushions stands against the parapet; on the right a small round blue-and-white mosaic table with two wooden folding chairs; big terracotta pots with a small lemon tree at the far right and lavender and herbs at the far left; a thin wooden post at each side edge carries a string of round light bulbs that sags in a gentle curve across the upper part of the frame

jobs.name: sky-day
jobs.prompt: A wide calm seascape seen from a rooftop: clear soft blue morning-to-noon sky with only a couple of faint thin clouds near the horizon, the sea horizon runs straight across at about 50% of the frame height, the calm sea below with gentle sparkles of sunlight, a small distant green island with a tiny white lighthouse on the right side of the horizon, a few far white sailboats. No buildings in the foreground, no terrace, no railing, nothing in front of the sea: the lower half is only open sea down to the bottom edge. {style}

jobs.name: sky-night
jobs.prompt: Repaint this exact seascape at night with the same composition: the horizon, the island and the lighthouse stay in exactly the same place. Deep navy starry sky with many small stars and a faint milky band, a crescent moon high on the upper left, a long silver moonlight reflection on the dark calm sea, the lighthouse lamp on the island glowing warm yellow with a soft beam, sailboats gone. Nothing in front of the sea. {style}

jobs.name: terrace-day
jobs.prompt: Only the foreground of a scene: {terrace}. Bright daytime sunlight from the upper left with soft shadows on the tiles. Everything above and behind the parapet wall (where the sky and the sea would be) is one perfectly flat solid pure magenta color #FF00FF with no gradient, no texture, no shadow, no glow; the magenta also shows between the light bulbs and through the gaps of the plants above the wall. The light bulbs are unlit. {style}

jobs.name: terrace-night
jobs.prompt: Repaint this exact image at night with exactly the same layout, objects and outlines: cool blue moonlight ambient on the white walls and the tiles, every round bulb of the string lights glowing warm yellow with small warm pools of light below them, a small glowing glass lantern on the mosaic table, warm light on the bench cushions. Keep every area that is pure magenta #FF00FF exactly the same flat solid magenta, with no glow, no darkening and no stars on it. {style}

jobs.name: clouds
jobs.prompt: Five separate soft fluffy white-and-cream cumulus clouds of different sizes floating in a loose horizontal row through the middle of the frame, painted with soft lavender shadow undersides, on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background with no gradient. No cloud touches the left, right, top or bottom edge of the image: leave a wide empty magenta margin all around. Nothing else in the image. {style}
